text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick thread to lock social plan for the Jun 21 webinar (performance + cost benchmarks). Need: 2 hero images, 2 short clips (15s), 3 quote cards, employee amp brief, seedlist segmentation, and monitoring rota. Who's on first 24h?
Owen (Social): I'll cover US daytime. Proposed schedule: X tease 24h prior, X main 09:15 PT, LinkedIn 09:45 PT, then X thread 6h after. Recommend A/B CTA on X (Register / Watch demo).
Lina (Content): Two caption directions ready: (A) straight bench: "See how teams reduced token spend up to 3x  live Jun 21." (B) human lead: "From 60ms to 12ms  learn how." Legal flagged the 3x language previously.
Ruth (Growth): Paid = bench (A) but legal wants "up to 3x" and a benchmark memo link. I'll fund $2k initial seed if Ops confirms tracking.
Ops-Bot: Confirmed: will create tag `webinar-jun21` in HubSpot and route inbound to SDR rotation. Will emit Slack alert to #inbound on paid-register clicks and create task if >4 signups/hr.
Dante (Design): Assets ETA EOD tomorrow. Will export: hero-wide.png (1200x628), hero-square.png (1080x1080), clip1.mp4 (burned captions), clip2.mp4, q1.png,q2.png,q3.png. Need final headlines for overlay.
Owen (Social): Micro-boost cadence: +1h, +6h, +18h, +36h. Employee amp note: 1-line share + 3 bullets (use case, demo link, recording). I'll draft and post.
Lina (Content): Quick engagement replies for SDRs: "Thanks — here's the link: https://redwood.ai/jun21 (register so we can follow-up)." and a DM template: "Hi {first}, saw your comment — are you evaluating inference costs now? Can we intro you to an engineer?"
Ruth (Growth): Seedlist segmentation: priority 1 = ML infra / platform teams; 2 = infra leads at SaaS scaleups; 3 = previous webinar registrants. I'll share sanitized CSV by 10am PT tomorrow.
Maya (Marketing): Checklist: captions + CTAs by EOD today, assets in drive by EOD tomorrow, seedlist to Ruth by 10am, monitoring doc live 1h before post. Any blockers?
Dante (Design): Not blocked. Will confirm safe zones for overlay.
Owen (Social): I'll upload scheduling CSV with UTMs (example row):
```
2026-06-21T09:15:00-07:00,X,"VariantA","hero-wide.png","?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_jun21&utm_content=variantA"
```
Maya (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks team  I'll run final check once scheduling doc is up.
